correctness.rationale: The branch domains are checked by positive-real-part estimates. Differentiation gives \(H_\alpha'(z)=\alpha M(z)^{\alpha-1}/((1-z)L(z))\); near each boundary height \(\tau_k=2\pi k/\log2\), \(|1-2^{-s}|\) is comparable to the Euclidean distance \(r\). Polar integration of \(\sigma |g_\alpha'|^2\) yields \(\mu(Q)\asymp_\alpha h(\log\log(e/h))^{2\alpha-2}/\log^2(e/h)\). A dyadic-shell bound supplies the uniform upper estimate. Thus the \(LMOA_{\mathcal D}\) profile has the stated trichotomy, and the cited general criteria imply the operator conclusions. No finite computation is treated as proof.
